_comment: English narration per site section, grounded in the actual page copy in assets/js/app.js. build_guide.py translates these into zh/yue/es/ne and generates mp3s via the free fish-audio/s2.1-pro-free:free model. The widget also uses 'text.en' as a Web Speech fallback when an mp3 is unavailable.
home: Welcome to shakya.work, the portfolio of Pranamyya Shakya. This is an AI portfolio spanning voice, agents, search and automation. You will find four core disciplines here: voice agents that talk in real time, enterprise search that answers with citations, agent networks that run operations, and workflow automation that turns plain language into action. Use this guide to tour the site hands free, and switch language anytime.
projects: This is the Projects page, a catalogue of production AI systems across voice, search and agent automation. Highlights include Voice GPT for enterprise inbound service, AI Calling for outbound sales and renewals, Debt Collection AI with compliant auditable conversations, Enterprise Search built on retrieval-augmented generation, Sales AI as a pipeline copilot, and Workflow Automation that compiles plain language into executable agent chains. Each one is shipped and scaled in real operations.
agents: The Agents page is a live dashboard for the agent network. Here you can monitor, manage and deploy AI agents across calling, collections and operations. You will see agents such as the Simulation Agent, Calling Agent, Collections Agent, Search Agent and Workflow Agent, each with its status, type and uptime. Tap the Simulation Agent to watch a voice pipeline run a test scenario step by step, from speech recognition through the language model to speech synthesis.
case-voice-gpt: This is the Voice GPT case study, a deep dive into a production conversational voice agent. Voice GPT runs enterprise inbound service lines end to end, combining speech recognition, a language model and speech synthesis. In one deployment at a tier-one bank it cut service costs by 62 percent while keeping responses under 400 milliseconds. It is the reference example of voice AI shipping to production.
ai-lab: AI Lab is where you try the systems, not just read about them. It has three working demos pulled from production: a voice agent playground showing a customer-service exchange at 380 millisecond latency, a prompt to workflow compiler, and an enterprise search demo that answers across contracts, SOPs and tickets with citations. Below that, a deployment table shows real outcomes, like a 62 percent cost reduction and 3.2 times recovery rate.
workflow: The Workflow page is about turning intent into automated pipelines. Using agent chains, a plain language request is compiled into an executable sequence of input, agent and output that runs policy as code. This is how repetitive business processes get rebuilt as reliable, observable AI workflows, the same engine behind the Workflow Automation product.
about: The About page introduces Pranamyya Shakya, a Product and AI Transformation Leader focused on voice, search and autonomous agents. The through line is simple: take AI from impressive demo to production systems that real teams use daily, across finance, logistics, healthcare and enterprise operations. The guiding principle here is shipped beats impressive, a finished deployed system always outlasts one endlessly polished in the lab.
contact: The Contact page is where conversations start. You can reach out by email at creation panel at gmail dot com, connect on LinkedIn, or message on WeChat at shakyain. There is also a short form to describe the problem you are solving. This is the best place to talk about collaborations, engagements, or swapping notes on AI.
voice: The Voice page focuses on voice agents and speech AI, the systems that actually talk to people. This includes Voice GPT for enterprise inbound service and AI Calling for outbound sales and renewals, all built on a speech recognition, language model and speech synthesis pipeline that responds in under 400 milliseconds. It is where conversational AI meets real phone lines.
search: The Search page is about enterprise search powered by retrieval augmented generation. Instead of keyword matching, it answers questions across contracts, SOPs and support tickets, and shows its sources. One deployment onboarded twelve teams onto cited, auditable answers drawn from the company's own knowledge.
cv: The CV page is the formal resume. It belongs to Shakya Tang, a product and AI leader who takes systems from pitch deck to production across voice, search and agent automation. It lists experience building enterprise voice platforms, retrieval augmented search used by twelve teams, and workflow automation that lifted recovery rates three point two times. Credentials include PMP, with work spanning voice AI, search, agent automation and enterprise go to market.
changelog: The Changelog page tracks what is new across the site and its projects, recent updates, launches and improvements. Check here to see how the portfolio and its AI systems have evolved over time.
blog: The Blog holds longer form writing, opinions, tutorials and field notes from building AI systems. It is where deeper thinking about voice, search, agents and automation gets written down.
